name: noodle
description: Syntax highlighting, step validation and autocompletion for Noodle .feature files

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Noodle launches a Python language server resolved from the workspace .venv, so opening an untrusted folder would run code from it.

noodle.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter that has noodle installed. Leave blank to auto-detect the workspace .venv, falling back to python3 (python on Windows). Machine-scoped: a cloned repo's .vscode/settings.json cannot point this at an executable of its choosing.

enumDescriptions: Yellow squiggle on steps the LLM will handle at runtime.
Blue dot in Problems panel only — no squiggle in the editor.
Silent — unknown steps show no indicator at all.
noodle.unknownStepSeverity.description: How to mark steps that don't match a built-in pattern.
